content: Some of the thanks go to the Defense Forces, and some go to Caster for keeping her promise.

content: Her Trilby Asher did indeed ensure the smooth evacuation of the Self-Salvation Corps.

content: The Duke of Caster...

content: ...I guessed your identity a long time ago. But now, no matter which of the dukes you're vassal or puppet of, I no longer care.

raw: [name="Lt. Colonel Lettou"]I may not know how capable you really are, but Londinium as she stands is no place for a rebellious child to be wandering around.
speaker: Lt. Colonel Lettou
content: I may not know how capable you really are, but Londinium as she stands is no place for a rebellious child to be wandering around.

raw: [name="Lt. Colonel Lettou"]Go back to your hiding place. Treasure the fact that the Sarkaz have not caught you yet. I'll pretend I never saw you.

content: Go back to your hiding place. Treasure the fact that the Sarkaz have not caught you yet. I'll pretend I never saw you.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]You've been cowering in Londinium for long enough.
speaker: Clovisia
content: You've been cowering in Londinium for long enough.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]After losing contact with the Self-Salvation Corps, I quickly found new objectives to work on within Londinium.
speaker: Clovisia
content: After losing contact with the Self-Salvation Corps, I quickly found new objectives to work on within Londinium.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]We... were betrayed too. And I don't even know who the traitors were.
speaker: Clovisia
content: We... were betrayed too. And I don't even know who the traitors were.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]But I don't have time to dwell on that. The situation within the city far surpasses our understanding of a nomadic city under occupation.
speaker: Clovisia
content: But I don't have time to dwell on that. The situation within the city far surpasses our understanding of a nomadic city under occupation.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]What's happening now is something you won't find in the history books.
speaker: Clovisia
content: What's happening now is something you won't find in the history books.

raw: [name="Lt. Colonel Lettou"]I know that better than anyone.

content: I know that better than anyone.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]But have you seen what's going on outside the city?
speaker: Clovisia
content: But have you seen what's going on outside the city?

raw: [name="Clovisia"]I've seen the Sarkaz Arts Circles, the red light in the sky, the war machines in their many forms, things unlike the military equipment of any ordinary nation.
speaker: Clovisia
content: I've seen the Sarkaz Arts Circles, the red light in the sky, the war machines in their many forms, things unlike the military equipment of any ordinary nation.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]I've seen hexcrafters floating in midair, seizing control of the sky, forcing drones and Arts alike to fail.
speaker: Clovisia
content: I've seen hexcrafters floating in midair, seizing control of the sky, forcing drones and Arts alike to fail.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]I used to think the descriptions of the Sarkaz military and the so-called 'Nachzehrer' were tall tales, literary embellishment for horror's sake.
speaker: Clovisia
content: I used to think the descriptions of the Sarkaz military and the so-called 'Nachzehrer' were tall tales, literary embellishment for horror's sake.

speaker: Clovisia
content: I don't think that anymore.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]When death itself opens its doors, what manmade hell do we face?
speaker: Clovisia
content: When death itself opens its doors, what manmade hell do we face?

raw: [name="Lt. Colonel Lettou"]And what of the dukes?

content: And what of the dukes?

raw: [name="Clovisia"]They stand on the horizon, out of reach.
speaker: Clovisia
content: They stand on the horizon, out of reach.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]I suppose you may be feeling guilt and melancholy, perhaps mixed with a dash of pride?
speaker: Clovisia
content: I suppose you may be feeling guilt and melancholy, perhaps mixed with a dash of pride?

raw: [name="Clovisia"]You ponder the cruel choices you've made, but your mission is now accomplished.
speaker: Clovisia

speaker: Clovisia
content: Londinium is too small, she can't contain the Sarkaz ambition. He is simply using this place to provoke the expansionist lust of Terra's other powers.

content: Do you honestly believe he cares at all for your Gaul?

content: Londinium's fall is complete, but you are no fool. You see it.

speaker: Clovisia

raw: [name="Lt. Colonel Lettou"]You are strong enough to subvert a nation, to change the course of history, not to mention... manipulate the fate of one or two men like me.

content: But Lettou, I hope we can—

speaker: Lt. Colonel Lettou
content: Let me by.

content: Then I can't say I wish you well.

speaker: Clovisia
content: René Lettou!
